title: packet-cql.c: additional improvements to CQLv5 dissection
description:
1. Some minor code cleanups
2. Query 'flags' field in v5 is an int, whereas in previous versions it was a single byte. Adjust the dissection
3. Show the header's CRC24 field - and move the *trailer's* CRC32 to its correct location in the dissection tree
4. Prepared result in v5 has an additional field - metadata ID
5. Unexpected negative value expert info for column length used to be set even if bytes length was 0 (which means no column data, but that's not wrong).

Signed-off-by: Yaniv Kaul <mykaul@gmail.com>

commits_data.title: packet-cql.c: additional improvements to CQL dissection
commits_data.message:
packet-cql.c: additional improvements to CQL dissection

1. Some minor code cleanups
2. CQL v5: query 'flags' field in v5 is an int, whereas in previous versions it was a single byte. Adjust the dissection.
3. CQL v5: show the header's CRC24 field - and move the *trailer's* CRC32 to its correct location in the dissection tree
4. CQL v5: prepared result in v5 has an additional field - metadata ID
5. Unexpected negative value expert info for column length used to be set even if bytes length was 0 (which means no column data - empty, but that's not wrong).

Signed-off-by: Yaniv Kaul <mykaul@gmail.com>
